text:
Morgan: Quick check-in on postmortem action items from Friday's outage. We need owners + dates for dedupe, threshold tuning, and paging policy updates.
Alex: I can own dedupe changes for backend CPU alerts. Plan: include trace_id/request_id in dedupe key, extend window to 10m, add flap cooldown. Will open PR by Tue EOD.
Lee: I'll run a threshold audit across the last 90d to identify transient CPU/GC spikes. Proposal: only page on >=95% sustained for 3m, keep lower thresholds for dashboards/alerts-no-page. Report ETA Mon.
Jiayi: I'll update the paging policy doc and runbook to reflect who gets paged at what time (infra vs runtime), plus an approval step for any suppression. Doc draft by Thu.
Stella: I'll create a weekly "noise sweep" recurring calendar (30m) and a checklist: check unique signatures, pages/hour, flapping alerts. Invite sent.
oncall-bot: Linked postmortem INC-2026-0319 and timeline added to the incident page.
Morgan: There's a recurring pattern: cache regeneration around 02:00-02:20 UTC causing frontend 5xx bursts. Suggest adding jitter/throttle to warmups and a circuit-breaker backoff. Any concerns?
Alex: No concerns. I'll change warmup_parallelism to 2 and add jitter rand(0,300)s. Will test in staging and link PR.
Lee: For suppression behavior: if same signature fires >5 times in 30m, convert to internal-only for 1h. I can add that rule to the alerting config.
Jiayi: We'll need product signoff if it affects user-facing alerts, but internal-only suppression is fine. I'll add signoff step to the doc.
Stella: Sharing a dashboard template tomorrow with queries: pages_per_hour, unique_signatures, avg_resolve_time.
Morgan: Please drop completion notes here when done and include AI IDs in the postmortem checklist. Action items: AI-101 dedupe (Alex) due 2026-04-07; AI-102 threshold audit (Lee) due 2026-04-05; AI-103 paging doc (Jiayi) due 2026-04-09; AI-104 noise sweep (Stella) recurring.
Alex: PR linked when ready.
Lee: Historical run started, ETA 48h.
Jiayi: Doc in review.
Stella: Invite: "eng-oncall: Noise Sweep" weekly Weds 09:00 UTC.
oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation updates deploy next Monday.
Morgan: Thanks all 8640. We'll reconvene after PRs/docs land.
